metadata.author: Anna Kim
metadata.title: Optima Weekly Update — April 16
metadata.demo_effect: Keeps the healthy comparison product current through the final demo wave.

payload.summary: Optima remains healthy with current weeklys, a complete transcript trail, and low-noise stakeholder communications. Accomplishments include delivering the April demo without scope change, publishing post-demo actions, and maintaining a low-risk posture. Next steps involve closing a low-priority dashboard defect and continuing Sprint 2 execution.
warnings: Only minor user training variability remains under observation.
